nodes.name: Webhook Novo Cliente
nodes.notes: Recebe multipart/form-data do formulario da area central: client_slug, client_name, client_email_to, client_contact_name, client_primary_color, e o arquivo 'logo'.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "ok": false, "error": "Preencha slug, e-mail do responsável e envie um logo." } }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ type: "A", name: $json.client_domain, content: "54.164.39.142", proxied: true, ttl: 1 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ name: "Dashboard " + $('Preparar Dados').first().json.client_name, domain: $('Preparar Dados').first().json.client_domain, type: "self_hosted", session_duration: "24h", app_launcher_visible: false }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ name: "Equipe " + $('Preparar Dados').first().json.client_name, decision: "allow", include: [ { email: { email: $('Preparar Dados').first().json.client_email_to } } ] }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ DocumentName: "AWS-RunShellScript", InstanceIds: ["i-05fd28179b086c305"], Parameters: { commands: $json.commands }, TimeoutSeconds: 300 }) }}

nodes.name: Provisionar via SSM
nodes.notes: TimeoutSeconds alto porque new-client.sh cria org+dashboards no Grafana e aguarda emissao de certificado SSL -- pode levar mais de 1 minuto.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "ok": true, "message": "Provisionamento disparado. O dashboard fica disponivel em alguns minutos (certificado SSL + politica de acesso).", "dashboard_url": "https://" + $('Montar Comando SSM').first().json.client_domain, "client_name": $('Montar Comando SSM').first().json.client_name } }}

meta.description: Motor de automacao da area central: recebe o formulario de novo cliente (multipart com upload de logo), cria DNS + Cloudflare Access, duplica o workflow TEMPLATE de relatorio mensal, e roda new-client.sh via SSM (credencial IAM restrita, so ssm:SendCommand nessa instancia -- ver modules/client-dashboard/new-client.sh). Requer 3 credenciais no n8n: Cloudflare (httpHeaderAuth, Bearer token com Zone:DNS:Edit + Account:Access Apps and Policies:Edit), n8n Self API (httpHeaderAuth, X-N8N-API-KEY), AWS SSM (aws, IAM restrito). IDs de credencial/zona/conta estao hardcoded nos nodes -- ajustar se reusar em outra conta Cloudflare/AWS.
